The dashboard shows all 50 US states. The color scale indicates that dark red corresponds to a risk index of 0 (low) and pale yellow corresponds to 100 (high). The chart shows Rhode Island (RI), New Mexico (NM), and Delaware (DE) are all colored dark red, indicating the lowest risk level. The routing criterion is not restricted to the offered options, so the selection must be based on the highest risk across all states shown.
